reviews.title: Haven’t used the app ****
reviews.text: I would be more likely to use it if it wasn’t AI ads trying to interact! I’m giving 3 for my interactions!

reviews.title: Not enough to upgrade
reviews.text: After about a week or so your camp will be fully upgraded and you will run out of objects to collect on your free spins. Every dry day you’ll have an “unlucky” free spin and get some coins that you won’t need because camp is fully finished and decked out in like the first 7 days. Really takes the motivation away. Especially when it’s $20 and there are plenty of free trackers out there.

reviews.title: Typical
reviews.text: I’ve seen this for weeks in my feed! Wanted to try it, answered all the personal questions, then at the end they give you a 7 day free trial… it’s going to take me longer than that to see a difference. $25 a month

reviews.title: Waste of money
reviews.text: Waste of money don’t buy. Will like at other apps. Can’t get a refund

reviews.title: Needs More
reviews.text: The app was cute for a couple weeks. But honestly, after several days of staying on target, it stopped updating my “camp” so there was no point in it, other than tracking. It basically asks the exact same questions every day and doesn’t really offer any insight. If you want to  just track your drinks. it’s probably OK. If you want more support, don’t waste your money.

reviews.title: They make you pay
reviews.text: They made me fill out my info for 10 minutes and then they forced me to pay to use the app

reviews.title: SCAM ALERT
reviews.text: Forces a subscription but claims a 7 day free trial before anything is charged. I selected monthly for $24.99/mo and again they confirmed no payment due today. Clicked submit and was instantly charged $54.98. Will be disputing this charge as fraud.

reviews.title: Love it!!!
reviews.text: I tried this as a free trial and got completely hooked!! It is awesome! I love the “chat” feature. I really wanted to journal my feelings and work through them, but never could write them down. Using the chat in this app is so easy. I love the interactive prompts that are the responses. I can pick up the phone and type a few sentences and get my feelings out so they pass. Love it!

reviews.title: Why
reviews.text: I don’t see why such a simple app needs to be paid for every month.

reviews.title: As a recovering Alki, Tipple has been a great influence
reviews.text: I’m a recovering Alki that’s struggled to cut off alcohol cold turkey and I’ve instead looked into moderation. Tipple is the perfect app for alcohol moderation, really gamifies the experience and makes the journey fun and digestible.

reviews.title: Good concept
reviews.text: Poor execution. I really like this idea. But there aren’t many features. Like adjusting the date. There are a ton of free drink trackers out there if that’s your goal. Not worth the price of the subscription
